event.title: Iran's Rial Hits Record Low Amid Upcoming US Sanctions
event.canonical_title: Iran's Rial Hits Record Low Amid Upcoming US Sanctions
event.summary: Iran's currency, the rial, has reached a new record low, trading at 2.02 million rials to the US dollar. This decline occurs as the United States is set to announce additional sanctions against Iran. The official Central Bank rate is approximately 1.5 million rials to the dollar, but the market rate reflects the price most Iranians encounter.

timeline.title: US Treasury Warns of Potential Economic Collapse in Iran
timeline.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has warned that Iran could face economic collapse within months due to ongoing economic pressures. His comments were made during a meeting with G20 finance ministers, where he sought to rally support among allies amid strained international relations caused by aggressive tariffs and the US's military actions in Iran.
key_facts: Scott Bessent warns of potential economic collapse in Iran.
Comments made during G20 finance ministers meeting.
US economic pressures include aggressive tariffs and military actions.
